events.name: Bash
events.head: Check guide state, screenshot, worker route
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git log --oneline -3 -- app/src/content/guides/s5-pipeline/s5-challenge-stages.ts; grep -n "PLANNED\|attended-day\|survey_submitted\|output_delivered\|02.webp\|capture" app/src/content/guides/s5-pipeline/s5-challenge-stages.ts | head -20; ls -la app/public/guides/s5-challenge-stages/ 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n "contactTimeline\|/crm/contact" cloud/funnel/worker.js | head; git diff --stat cloud/funnel/worker.js

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run T-266 probe and check-guides
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; (node cloud/scripts/probe-t266.mjs 2>&1 | grep -c PASS; node cloud/scripts/probe-t266.mjs 2>&1 | grep -E "FAIL|passed|of" | tail -3) ; cd app && node scripts/check-guides.mjs 2>&1 | tail -4; ls scripts | grep -i probe-guides

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run probe-guides
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; head -15 scripts/probe-guides.mjs | grep -E "^//" ; timeout 300 node scripts/probe-guides.mjs 2>&1 | tail -4

events.text: Running the guide render probe against the local dev server now.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start dev server, probe guide, stop server
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; (npx next dev -p 3137 > /tmp/t136-dev.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 60); do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://localhost:3137/guides/s5-challenge-stages" | grep -q 200 && break; sleep 2; done; MECH=challenge WIDTHS=1440,390 node scripts/probe-guides.mjs "http://localhost:3137/guides/s5-challenge-stages?v=t136-1011b" 2>&1 | tail -4; lsof -ti:3137 | xargs kill
